text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's give a warm welcome to Kitasan Black! Or as we call her, Li'l Miss!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Everyone, thank you so much for putting on this fantastic event for me to show off my racewear!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Man A
text_block_list.text: Whaddaya talkin' about? Don't act so distant! What's a party or two for our Li'l Miss, eh?

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Lady A
text_block_list.text: You said it! The Li'l Miss Cheer Squad's been waitin' forever and a half to see you in your signature racewear!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Not you too, Trainer! But thank you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's thanks to all your support that it turned out so gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You gave me so much good advice while I was thinking up the design!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Like this blue ocean wave pattern here—

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Man B
text_block_list.text: That was my idea! It symbolizes our desire for you to be healthy and keep runnin' forever!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm gonna keep it up and run forever and ever! Ooh, and this plum and cherry design represents the idea that—

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Lady B
text_block_list.text: If you persist, endure, and work hard, you'll eventually bloom beautifully!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! So, please be there to see me when I fully bloom! I'll keep believing in myself and everyone else!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Man A
text_block_list.text: Of course, the most important thing's the silhouette of your racewear!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Man A
text_block_list.text: When we think of ya, we think of festivals, so we decided to base the shape of your racewear on a traditional festival jacket!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Lady A
text_block_list.text: It was a good idea too! You've been carryin' the portable shrines with us since you were a young'un! I've got no objections to you wearin' that!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I won't let you down! I'll channel all my pride as a festival lover and make my races more exciting than anyone's!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone, for all the thought and care you put into my signature racewear!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooo! Clap, clap, clap…
choice_data_list: You've given real form to all their hopes and dreams!
You've given real form to all their hopes and dreams!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Good! That means I can literally carry those hopes and dreams with me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Their well wishes for my good health and success, their unshakeable faith in me… It all gives me strength.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's why I'll bear the weight of all their feelings and tear up the racetrack in my signature racewear!
choice_data_list: Do the colors of your decorative cord stand for something too?
Let's turn those hopes into reality together!
Let's turn those hopes into reality together!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's why I'll bear the weight of all their feelings and tear up the racetrack in my signature racewear!
choice_data_list: Do the colors of your decorative cord stand for something too?
Let's turn those hopes into reality together!
Let's turn those hopes into reality together!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Well, you see, I was the one who chose the colors for it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Red and white are an auspicious combination, and just seeing them can energize people!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I wanted to give back some of the energy I get from my fans, which is why I chose these colors for the cord!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Man A
text_block_list.text: Don't be silly! Your runnin' and singin's always been a real source of energy and encouragement for us!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haha! Then I'd better work even harder to get on a real big stage and wow you all!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Lady A
text_block_list.text: I'll be dreamin' of that day! But for now, sing for us!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Lady B
text_block_list.text: I second that! Let us hear that beautiful vibrato of yours, Kita!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Your wish is my command! I'll sing for you all as much as you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Man B
text_block_list.text: Go fer it, Kita! Let's hear you sing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The air fills with Kitasan Black's passionate singing and her fans' enthusiastic cheers. The locals' love for her is stronger than ever today.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sounds like a plan! I'm counting on you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: With you by side, I'm guaranteed to make everyone's dreams a reality!
choice_data_list: You've got it! Leading you to success is my job!
You've got it! Leading you to success is my job!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Aw, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Lady A
text_block_list.text: That's the kinda bond I like to see! You've got yourself a good, dependable trainer there!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Man B
text_block_list.text: All right! Three cheers for Li'l Miss and her trainer! Hip-hip, hooray!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Members
text_block_list.text: Hooray for Trainer! Heave-ho, heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Lady A
text_block_list.text: Hey now! Who's callin' out "heave-ho"?! We're not carryin' a portable shrine!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! It's okay, ma'am! Come on, Trainer. Heave-hooo!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Members
text_block_list.text: Li'l Miss, heave-hooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black shoulders the hopes of her home, and it's clear she loves everyone there deeply. After what I witnessed today, I can safely say that the feeling is mutual.
